test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 11 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/148f11f9737c7be4e5fa4c443407496e71769d4086d4f598e4415d68bb17daf2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The Alphabet 'C' has shifted one place up and down alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7b2e4873adca4e9bf2995f1a8a9c6caead75336342c1e5dfe57791ab9b20fae.png] 

Step II: The Symbol ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d024dde22b0bed816c305be386392043db53811a6db9a08c2acc6cb75249ff22.png] ' has shifted one place up and down alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ba307c57dfe1868cb83e40dbce013bef040deaa47b3c15fbd1adf880aaa8d24.png] 

Step III: The Alphabet 'X' is replaced with 'M' and then 'S' and shifted one place up and down alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff666234d99b21244b87ad1e75ebb79b5813e82050e68d00a80450d9b84f7b30.png] 

Step IV: The Symbol '-' is replaced with Symbol ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da442b2c4117af150d9ad64fa3cc8271dd4effaf93c8425c2c23bea5036631f7.png] ' and then alphabet 'T' and shifted one place up and down alternatively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d160c6e2316825162246bfcba6a505ba183e7fe85ef912964f35ba24316db511.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb5fb8fc60215c355554726778b1e7f87f09411ff85d86d1a394aa41ab85283d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
